description: A curated gene–pathway membership relationship linking a human Gene to a human Pathway. Membership comes from WikiPathways or from the Reactome and PID collections distributed through PathwayCommons. Only memberships whose genes are represented in SPOKE are included. A gene–pathway pair is represented once, even if the source repeats the gene.

source_contributions.scope: Human (Homo sapiens) pathways and their gene memberships, limited to genes represented in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: Community-curated pathway membership from the Homo sapiens GMT release. Memberships are associated with NCBI Gene identifiers.

source_contributions.scope: Human gene memberships from the reactome and pid upstream collections only. Other upstream collections are excluded. Memberships without a corresponding SPOKE Gene are absent.
source_contributions.description: Curated pathway membership from the Reactome and PID collections in the PathwayCommons meta-database. The source represents genes using HGNC symbols.
